origine_fr: En bas, le cœur, sous la forme 㣺 ; en haut, 莫, qui donnait le son mais se lit mò, plus mù. Le cœur se tourne vers quelqu'un. C'est admirer, envier, comme dans 羡慕.
origine_en: At the bottom, the heart, in the form 㣺; on top, 莫, which gave the sound but is now read mò, not mù. The heart turns towards someone. That is to admire, to envy, as in 羡慕.

mots.en: to admire, to look up to
to adore, to be in love with

phrase.zh: 很多人仰慕这位老作家。
phrase.pinyin: Hěn duō rén yǎngmù zhè wèi lǎo zuòjiā.
phrase.fr: Beaucoup de gens admirent ce vieil écrivain.
phrase.en: Many people look up to this old writer.
